sentences.text: Corvale East holds 115 units of gabapentin at 16.1 per day, giving 7 days on hand.
Corvale Lakeside holds 82 units at 4.6 per day, giving 18 days on hand.
Both sites use the same NDC 72737000503 labeled by Stallion Laboratories Private Limited.
The label links to plant FEI 3013353854, which FDA inspected and classified VAI on 2024-07-12.
The inspection classification was known to FDA on 2024-09-28 per an FMD-145 letter.
Check whether the VAI classification has led to any shipping holds or allocation limits from this manufacturer.

Q-431927.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%gabapentin%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%gabapentin%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-20dc50.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('b26fd0c6-6aab-4957-8a32-cc7adb9b5fc9') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-3f53c5.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%gabapentin%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-64d8b9.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%gabapentin%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-9e497e.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%gabapentin%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%capsule%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-ecac8d.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3013353854', '3001452204', '1641825', '3011557028', '2000021110') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-0185c5.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3013353854', '3001452204', '1641825', '3011557028', '2000021110') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-8f0c62.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3013353854') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('stallion')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-48238c.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('stallion') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%gabapentin%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-ae129a.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('72737000503')

Q-5488a9.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%gabapentin%'
